author: CBR
description:
Jason Aaron explains the mindset behind Marvel’s Star Wars comics: go for big moments and make the stories feel essential, not “random” filler between A New Hope and The Empire Strikes Back. He also reacts to Star Wars #1 selling around a million copies, prompting him to reread the script because he knew fans would scrutinize every line for years.

🎙️ Clip from CBR’s Heroes Journey Podcast – Episode 14.
